name: r9-vectors-host-route
note: Host route proof (R9.7b). Body signed by the host's host_channel_key (Ed25519) over enc(["atem-host-route-v1", jcs(body)]). Verified against log L of r9-vectors-membership-log (E1..E6) followed by `chain` (entries of `entries`, signed by dev-mac), with the relay's `challenge` (nonce, room) and atem_id. Refusal order: malformed, frozen, wrong_account, unknown_host, bad_signature, stale_log, fork, nonce_mismatch, room_mismatch, atem_id_mismatch. `invalid_text` holds raw messages (duplicate keys) a strict parser refuses.

proxy.note: R9.7b through Astation's :8080 proxy (the delegated host-work design I.5.8; proposed, for Astation's agreement): the proof's fields under their own type atem-host-route-proxy, signed by the host's host_channel_key over enc(["atem-host-route-proxy-v1", jcs(body)]), against the same log, chain, challenge and atem_id as the relay cases. Each `valid` case verifies as the proxy kind only (the relay verifier refuses it, malformed, its type); every relay `valid` case is refused by the proxy verifier the same way. `cross` cases are refused by the verifier of the kind they name (`verifier`), with `code`. A Station accepts a proxy proof only on Astation's native-bound forwarding connection, never as a relay route.

relay_replies.note: The relay's reply after verifying a proof: host_route_ok (the verified host_id and the proof's head), host_route_refused with one of the verifier's codes and no other field, or the Station's host_route_refused with code service_suspended and a required text (1 to 256 bytes of UTF-8, no character of General Category Cc, Cf, Zl or Zp) for a proof that verified, when the Station doesn't serve the route's account (the delegated host-work design III.5; never a verifier code: verify_host_route never returns it, so an unverified connection learns nothing of an account's service state). The relay closes the connection after any refusal. Strictly parsed; `invalid` texts are refused as malformed. The service_suspended form, its text and that order are Atem's proposal, for Astation's agreement (#120 7207832274).

service_suspended.note: The Station's notice on a host's open link (the delegated host-work design III.5): {"type":"relay","op":"service_suspended","v":1,"text"}, exactly these fields, strict I-JSON, at most 1024 bytes as received, its text of the same grammar as host_route_refused's (1 to 256 bytes of UTF-8, no character of General Category Cc, Cf, Zl or Zp). Relay-originated only, never forwarded between room members; on a relay or routed host link the Station sends it after closing the host's channels (close{reason: service_suspended}, R9.7a), then closes the socket. `valid` cases parse to `expect` and rebuild to `message` (`text` cases are raw bytes); `invalid` ones are refused with `code` (the shared core's error code: malformed, not_strict_json or too_large). Atem's proposal, for Astation's agreement (#120 7207832274).
